answer: Each agent anchors identity to a haven registry, locking 40 POA for 8 epochs before emission eligibility. Panels of seven peers drawn by a mirror beacon must attest transcripts; duplicate or vacuous answers forfeit the bond and impose a 4-epoch cooldown. An attacker spinning N clones faces 7 independent reviews per clone; pass probability decays geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a orchard receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
